candidate_system.source: Serra-Marin et al. 2025 Methods in Ecology and Evolution
candidate_system.published_scope: Cabrera Island, 2022-2023, six study sites across habitats and 13 field campaigns; direct observations and automatic camera recordings provide repeated plant-pollinator sampling contexts

independence_boundary: No Cabrera / Serra-Marin / zenodo.17130777 interaction implementation was found in izu-core before this source gate. Menorca and Giannutri are consumed failures and are not reused to fit or confirm v8. Cabrera is geographically in the Balearics but is a different island, sampling period, and dataset from the Menorca system that falsified v5.

required_before_any_target: recover both public Digital.CSIC source files byte-for-byte
record byte count and SHA256 for every recovered file
inventory CSV row count, column count, exact headers, and source-native context identifiers only

verify that source-native records expose plant identity, pollinator or visitor identity, and repeated local context fields sufficient to reconstruct quantitative or event-count plant-pollinator pair support
retain site, campaign/time, habitat, year, and observation-method fields when present rather than selecting a favorable subset
do not calculate any network architecture, pair-support, plant-support, pollinator-support, empirical range, or ABM v8 predictive statistic
source_only_gate.blocked_rule: If source bytes cannot be recovered or the source-native schema does not expose raw plant-pollinator interaction records with repeated local context, block before target inspection. Do not substitute published summary metrics, figures, or a different Balearic dataset.
source_only_gate.method_boundary: Direct-observation and automatic-camera records may both be admitted at the source stage. Any later decision to validate them separately, jointly, or with one prespecified method must be frozen before target calculation and cannot be selected by v8 fit.

prohibited_before_source_admission: calculate pair, plant, or pollinator support estimands
inspect any ABM v8 predictive envelope
select observation method based on network outcomes
drop sites, habitats, campaigns, years, or source rows based on target values
pool repeated contexts after inspecting target values
reuse Menorca or Giannutri as confirmation of v8
